title: A Light Above the Pit
summary: Villagers saw a beam of light rise from the Wither's pit into the clouds. Mara says to ignore it. The cleric's grandmother said glowstone and water open a door to heaven. Build an Aether portal.

goals.say: Glowstone and water. The cleric's grandmother called it the door to heaven.

quest_book.title: Leave the Sky Alone
quest_book.author: Old Mara
pages:
I hear the villagers saw a light go up from your pit.

Ignore it. There is nothing above the clouds but old, proud things that will not help you.

Go to the End instead. Find a stronghold. The next Warden waits there.

Please. - M.
